docket_entries.description: MASTER COURT CALENDAR SET FOR OCT-13-2020 - APPEARANCES AT TRIAL CALL BY KERI EVILSIZOR, ESQ. SPECIALLY APPEARING FOR PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL, STEVEN KOCH, ESQ.; DEFENDANT LORETTA LIM, SELF-REPRESENTED LITIGANT, WITH SON BRENDEN LIM. THE COURT GRANTED PLAINTIFF'S ORAL MOTION TO CONTINUE THE TRIAL DATE WITH A CONTINUANCE FEE OF $60 TO BE PAID IN ROOM 103. MS. EVILSIZOR TO CONVEY TO MR. KOCH THAT THE COURT ORDERED HIM TO CALL DEFENDANT BY 2:00PM TODAY, 10/13/20, TO START SETTLEMENT DISCUSSIONS IN AN EFFORT TO RESOLVE THE MATTER. THE TRIAL DATE IS CONTINUED TO OCT-28-2020 AT 9:30 AM IN 206. ALL PARTIES ORDERED TO APPEAR. JUDGE: SAMUEL K. FENG; MATTER NOT REPORTED (206/SKF)
